correctness.rationale: The finite-N process contracts synchronously under positive confinement. Its stationary first and second moments satisfy explicit closed generator equations. value.rationale: The exact dimensionless Pearson law gives a sharp, physically motivated N-scale coupling boundary between negligible and persistent normalized pair correlations under independent resets, directly addressing the local/global reset distinction in the motivating model. The exact two-mode time regression and N^{-1}-lag layer identify a second temporal scale, and law-independence of resetting targets demonstrates structural universality; it is not an unmotivated finite enumeration or a one-particle moment substitution.
